acc-cross-repo-caller-scoped.description: Adopter opt-in to SCP-R-006 (ACC-as-cross-repo-caller invariants per D-036 / RULE-003). Default false; rule does not fire when absent or false. See docs/decisions/D-036-acc-cross-repo-caller-pair-2026-05-24.md.

acc-hook-installed.description: Adopter opt-in to SCP-R-030 (hooked-repo onboarding conformance). Set true ONLY in a repo that runs the acc-hook AND whose CLAUDE.md carries the canonical onboarding preamble. Default false; rule vacuous-passes when absent or false. Reversibility uses the generic rules.SCP-R-030.disable (+justification +expires_at) path, NOT a bespoke key. See docs/decisions/D-058-scp-canonical-conformance-strategy-2026-05-29.md + docs/plans/WP-SCP-030-hooked-repo-onboarding-conformance-v1.md.

estate-context-marker.description: Adopter opt-in to SCP-R-031 (estate-context bootstrap marker linkage). Set true ONLY in a repo whose CLAUDE.md AND AGENTS.md carry the canonical control-tower marker '<!-- canonical:estate-context-bootstrap v1 -->' in their top-of-file block. Default false; rule vacuous-passes when absent or false. Reversibility uses the generic rules.SCP-R-031.disable (+justification +expires_at) path, NOT a bespoke key. control-tower owns the marker contract (contracts/estate-context-marker.md); SCP gates linkage only (D-058). See docs/plans/WP-SCP-031-estate-context-marker-linkage-v1.md.

auth-canonical-version-pin-disabled.description: Adopter opt-out of SCP-R-009 (auth-canonical-version-pin; WP-SCP-028). Default false = the rule is active for adopters that consume a ct-auth-* SDK. Set true to silence it (equivalent to rules.SCP-R-009.disable but without the justification/expires_at ceremony, for a low-friction warn-baseline opt-out during the D-059 observation window). See docs/plans/WP-SCP-028-auth-canonical-conformance-v1.md.

auth-canonical-import-fence-disabled.description: Adopter opt-out of SCP-R-010 (auth-canonical-import-fence; WP-SCP-028). Default false = the rule is active for files that import the ct-auth SDK. Set true to silence it. See docs/plans/WP-SCP-028-auth-canonical-conformance-v1.md.

auth-contract-claim-shape-disabled.description: Adopter opt-out of SCP-R-011 (auth-contract-claim-shape; WP-SCP-028). Default false = the rule is active for files that handle Authorization headers. Set true to silence it. See docs/plans/WP-SCP-028-auth-canonical-conformance-v1.md.

threshold-overrides.description: Per-adopter per-rule threshold override. Reuses the {warn, deny, disable, off} enum introduced by RULE-002 §3.2. Affects only ramp-able invariants; unconditional-deny invariants (e.g. SCP-R-006 Inv-C tamper detection) are exempt.
